Good — then the BC04 is the right first one. 6 TH/s at about 100 W, so roughly $12 a month in power at 16¢, and it's quiet enough for a desk at ~50 dB.

It draws for a full block every ten minutes, stacks small Bitcoin payouts to your own wallet meanwhile, and teaches you how pools and wallets actually work.

Want me to set one up?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-1 numbers for where you live.
